title: Verify the sidebar 'Work Order Fees & Discounts' card lists whole-work-order fees/discounts with name, signed rate and grey amount
custom_preconds:
1. You are logged in with See Financial Data and Work Orders: Create & Edit.
2. An open work order with a whole-work-order discount plus some line-level fees/discounts.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the 'Work Order Fees & Discounts' card on the left.
2. Read the listed entries and check which scopes appear.
3. Open an entry's ⋮ (more) menu.
custom_expected:
1. The card is titled 'Work Order Fees & Discounts' and lists ONLY whole-work-order fees/discounts — line-level ones do not appear here.
2. Each entry shows its name, a signed rate badge (for example '−8%' or a dollar amount) and the resolved amount in grey, signed.
3. The entry's ⋮ menu offers 'Edit' and 'Remove'.
The 'Work Order Fees & Discounts' card renders above the Financial Info card in the sidebar.
